answer: The jade counter is kept in pulse and spiral exposes each reset. An adversary therefore has to keep each alias continuously active for 46 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 46 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1026 identities would post 1924 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
